cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: The Approved Explanation
cards.instruction: Protect someone or the group by maintaining a simplified account that everyone can safely repeat.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell the children the trip's postponed for bus repairs. Use the calm opening I taught you; they'll worry about Mr Patel.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He's fine. His parked bus rolled into the pond.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you started with him being fine. Stop there, then say the bus needs repairs. You used to lead with the splashiest detail.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The parents will ask if he was driving.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then everybody says, 'The parked bus needs repairs; Mr Patel is fine.' Give the office that exact line too. You can keep three audiences on one account now.
